SELECT
	Code=InstallmentHeader.InstallmentCode, 
	SaleInvCode=InstallmentHeader.SaleInvCode,
	Date=InstallmentHeader.Date, 
	AliasName = Accounts.AliasName,
	CustCode = Accounts.AccCode,
	Customer = Accounts.Name,
	installmentguarantor.GuaranteePersonCode,
	GuaranteePerson=(SELECT G.Name FROM GuaranteePerson G WHERE G.GuaranteePersonCode = installmentguarantor.GuaranteePersonCode),
	Godown = (SELECT G.Name FROM Godown G WHERE G.GCode = InstallmentHeader.GCode),
	CustomICode = Item.CustomICode,
	ItemName = Item.Name, 
	Qty = InstallmentHeader.Qty, 
	SalePrice=InstallmentHeader.SalePrice, 
	InstallmentFrequency=InstallmentHeader.InstallmentFrequency, 
	NoOfInstallments=InstallmentHeader.NoOfInstallments,
	ContractAmt = Round(Round((InstallmentHeader.qty * (InstallmentHeader.saleprice - InstallmentHeader.itemflatdisc) ) * (1 - InstallmentHeader.discperc * 0.01), 2)  + InstallmentHeader.markupamt + InstallmentHeader.processingfee, 0),
	UserCode=(SELECT U.UserName FROM Users U WHERE U.UserCode=InstallmentHeader.UserCode),
	Remarks=InstallmentHeader.Remarks,
	Posted=InstallmentHeader.Posted, 
	PostedBy = (SELECT U.UserName FROM Users U WHERE U.UserCode=InstallmentHeader.PostedBy),
	PostDate=InstallmentHeader.PostDate,
	Approved=InstallmentHeader.Approved,
	ApprovedBy=(SELECT U.UserName FROM Users U WHERE U.UserCode=InstallmentHeader.ApprovedBy),
	ApprovedOn=InstallmentHeader.ApprovedOn,
	Rejected=InstallmentHeader.Rejected,
	RejectedBy=(SELECT U.UserName FROM Users U WHERE U.UserCode=InstallmentHeader.RejectedBy),
	RejectedOn=InstallmentHeader.RejectedOn
FROM
	InstallmentHeader, Accounts, Item, installmentguarantor
WHERE
	InstallmentHeader.CustCode=Accounts.AccCode AND
	InstallmentHeader.InstallmentCode=installmentguarantor.InstallmentCode AND
	InstallmentHeader.ICode = Item.ICode
UNION
SELECT
	Code=InstallmentHeader.InstallmentCode, 
	SaleInvCode=InstallmentHeader.SaleInvCode,
	Date=InstallmentHeader.Date, 
	AliasName = Accounts.AliasName,
	CustCode = Accounts.AccCode,
	Customer = Accounts.Name,
	GuaranteePersonCode=NULL,
	GuaranteePerson=NULL,
	Godown = (SELECT G.Name FROM Godown G WHERE G.GCode = InstallmentHeader.GCode),
	CustomICode = Item.CustomICode,
	ItemName = Item.Name, 
	Qty = InstallmentHeader.Qty, 
	SalePrice=InstallmentHeader.SalePrice, 
	InstallmentFrequency=InstallmentHeader.InstallmentFrequency, 
	NoOfInstallments=InstallmentHeader.NoOfInstallments,
	ContractAmt = Round(Round((InstallmentHeader.qty * (InstallmentHeader.saleprice - InstallmentHeader.itemflatdisc) ) * (1 - InstallmentHeader.discperc * 0.01), 2)  + InstallmentHeader.markupamt + InstallmentHeader.processingfee, 0),
	UserCode=(SELECT U.UserName FROM Users U WHERE U.UserCode=InstallmentHeader.UserCode),
	Remarks=InstallmentHeader.Remarks,
	Posted=InstallmentHeader.Posted, 
	PostedBy = (SELECT U.UserName FROM Users U WHERE U.UserCode=InstallmentHeader.PostedBy),
	PostDate=InstallmentHeader.PostDate,
	Approved=InstallmentHeader.Approved,
	ApprovedBy=(SELECT U.UserName FROM Users U WHERE U.UserCode=InstallmentHeader.ApprovedBy),
	ApprovedOn=InstallmentHeader.ApprovedOn,
	Rejected=InstallmentHeader.Rejected,
	RejectedBy=(SELECT U.UserName FROM Users U WHERE U.UserCode=InstallmentHeader.RejectedBy),
	RejectedOn=InstallmentHeader.RejectedOn
FROM
	InstallmentHeader, Accounts, Item
WHERE
	InstallmentHeader.CustCode=Accounts.AccCode AND
	InstallmentHeader.ICode = Item.ICode AND
	InstallmentHeader.InstallmentCode NOT IN (SELECT installmentguarantor.InstallmentCode FROM installmentguarantor)
UNION
SELECT
